Tim Cook Steps Down as Apple CEO After 15 Years

Tim Cook has stepped down as CEO of Apple after 15 years leading the company. He announced his departure in a final memo to employees, stating he would miss the work. His tenure saw the introduction of several key Apple products. Cook's farewell marks the end of a significant era for the technology giant.
